sources.entry: Tribler - Privacy enhanced BitTorrent client with P2P content discovery.

summary.one_liner: Tribler is a BitTorrent client aimed at anonymous torrent downloading, with a Tor-like network, hidden-service seeding, and end-to-end encryption.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Tribler as a BitTorrent client focused on anonymous access to content. It says the project runs its own enhanced Tor-like network for anonymous torrent downloads, with hidden-services-based seeding and end-to-end encryption. The README lists Discord for community chat, an issue tracker for bug reports and feature requests, and documentation covering development and building. It is distributed under GPL-3.0. The README does not describe install steps or the specific features of the client UI, and it gives no run commands beyond pointing to the latest release download and a Flathub alternative.
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the project's releases page (linked in the README)
Alternatively install the Flathub build (linked in the README)
For development and building instructions, see the project documentation linked in the README
notable: Own enhanced Tor-like anonymous network for torrent downloading
Available as a Flathub package in addition to direct release downloads
caveats: README does not detail platform support beyond the release download and Flathub links
Fedora 42+ and pure GNOME users are pointed to a separate tray icon guide for system tray support
